thread:
maria: Noticing a small but persistent parse-failure bump in the int4 canary for 'hera-lite' when streaming funcalls + kvcache are enabled. Rate ~0.6%. Sample attached.

lee: Can you paste the failing payload?

maria: Sure:
```
{"tool":"get_profile","args":{"id":"u-99"}}
�
```
Trailing NUL after a perfectly valid JSON. Parser rejects on strict schema.

noah: Is this only on int4? Any fp16/int8 mirrors?

maria: Mirrors on fp16 + int8 show baseline. Only int4 nightly reproduces it.

ops-bot: canary-1756001111 started sandbox-int4-11 at 09:12 UTC. parse_fail_rate=0.58% (baseline 0.02%). Dump id: hl-902.

sam: Quick mitigation: add an optional sanitizer that trims trailing control bytes (<=0x1f) before lint. Emit telemetry tag `sanitized_trailing_control`. Keep off for canaries.

lee: For root cause: collect raw token ids and post-assembly bytes for failing cases. Compare merge behavior with kvcache on/off. Also run microbatching=false to isolate batch_recombine.

maria: kvcache-off run lowered rate to 0.01% — strong signal. Uploading token-id traces to ML-ONBOARD-1999.

noah: Likely a kvcache fragment glue issue where a pad sentinel isn't removed or a buffer alignment byte leaks. Add a unit in fragment-assembler that simulates pad bytes between prefix and live output.

ci-bot: CI job added: struct-output-fuzz-pad (inject 0x00..0x1f at joins).

sam: Plan: (1) short-term sanitizer + telemetry (maria), (2) unit+fuzz tests (noah), (3) defensive trim in assembler behind flag (lee), (4) bisect recent kvcache/assembler commits if tests fail (sam).

maria: Opening a PR for sanitizer and uploading failing dumps. Will keep the canary strict and only enable sanitizer for opted-in customers.

lee: Good. If bisect points at token-map changes we'll coordinate with infra/kernel team. Thanks.
